question: Should Telegram expose standalone `pin` and `unpin` message-tool actions, and what gate plus target semantics should protect them?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this expands agent authority over persistent Telegram chat state and current config has no pin-specific gate or approved implicit-unpin contract.

options.title: Approve Gated Explicit Actions
options.body: Add Telegram-plugin-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind a maintainer-approved gate, require explicit `messageId` unless implicit unpin is deliberately approved, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Delivery Pin Only
options.body: Do not expose standalone pin/unpin actions yet, and rely on the existing `delivery.pin` path for pinning messages OpenClaw just sent.

options.title: Request Design First
options.body: Ask for a small design covering admin-right expectations, per-account gating, implicit unpin behavior, and forum-topic semantics before code work.

recommendation.title: Approve Gated Explicit Actions
recommendation.body: Add Telegram-plugin-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind a maintainer-approved gate, require explicit `messageId` unless implicit unpin is deliberately approved, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior work owns the Telegram message-tool discovery and runtime seam that would be extended by this decision.
